question.html:
A sample containing of an ideal monatomic gas is kept within a cylinder fitted with a frictionless piston. The gas undergoes a series of thermodynamic processes starting from an initial state.

a

In an adiabatic compression, of work is done on the gas by the surroundings. Calculate the change in the internal energy () of the gas and state whether the temperature of the gas increases or decreases.

[2]

b

The gas is then returned to its initial state and heated at a constant volume. During this isochoric process, the temperature of the gas rises from to . Calculate the amount of heat energy () supplied to the gas.

[3]
